environment.network: Local production preview; no network or CPU throttling

methodology.build: Production Vite build runs in a child that exits before browser measurement, releasing build-only heap for all three libraries. Preview and build share the same config. This reduces unrelated controller memory, without claiming a proven cause/fix for historical native-layout stalls. BENCH_NO_BUILD reuses an existing unchanged bundle.
methodology.fullDOM: Production React. GFM only, native code, identical neutral CSS. No virtualisation, animation, highlight or deferred rendering. Fresh page per trial, two small warmups, cyclic/reversed renderer order. Each synchronous flushSync commit includes forced layout; one rAF between chunks; separate final=true commit included. CDP TaskDuration also captures asynchronous browser work. Final semantic DOM compared to react-markdown + remark-gfm outside timing. JS heap measured after CDP GC, not total process memory.
methodology.reading: Independent cold browser context per renderer, production build. LiMR and Markstream retain default plugins/options and vendor CSS; react-markdown uses remark-gfm, remark-math, rehype-katex and an async Shiki component, neutral article CSS. LiMR default Markdown + full styles including Maple; Markstream default MarkdownRender + CSS with optional stream-diffs and KaTeX installed. Real local images; unique code/math. First readable frame is a two-rAF DOM-readiness proxy, not FCP/LCP. Compositor wheel gesture over 7 seconds, then middle/end seeks. Scroll rAF telemetry excludes snapshot scans and GC. Resource totals are measured local transfers, not npm installation or compressed bundle sizes.
methodology.hostSnapshots: Full-DOM trials record host/procfs and renderer process/main-thread CPU before and after the whole run, outside page commit timing. These boundaries include trailing rAFs and adjacent CDP metric calls, not only flushSync. CPU ticks use clockTicksPerSecond; process CPU includes workers. Node RSS/heap is also recorded around build and reference SSR. No periodic sampling or tracing is enabled in ordinary runs. Host-wide pressure/reclaim counters show correlation, not process attribution. Unavailable OS fields are null.
